channel.title: AI Broadside
channel.description: News of artificial intelligence, ranked and printed daily: research, tutorials, tools and releases. Every link goes to the original publisher.

item.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
item.description: Google DeepMind's announcement of Genie 4, the next version of its interactive world-simulation model. Coverage elsewhere points to audio, more realistic physics and real-time steering.

item.title: GPT-6.1 Terra
item.description: Simon Willison’s notes on GPT-6.1 Terra, a new OpenAI model. Secondhand testing and commentary, not the vendor post.

item.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
item.description: Preprint describing a second EmbeddingGemma model aimed at unified, efficient multimodal representations. Title only; no benchmarks are visible.

item.title: The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning
item.description: Google Research post introducing a sleep framework intended to help LLMs retain knowledge during continual learning. Based on the title and source.

item.title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
item.description: TechCrunch explains a claim by frontier labs that their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. Claim is as reported and unverified here.

item.title: NIST Report Provides Guidelines for Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography Standards
item.description: NIST report with guidelines for moving to post-quantum cryptography standards. Regulator document, not AI-specific.

item.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Terra
item.description: OpenAI announces GPT-6.1 Terra, a new model in its GPT-6.1 line, also covered by an independent blogger.

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing lays out a plan to ‘revolutionize every area of human endeavor’ with AI
item.description: The Verge reports on Anthropic’s IPO filing and the company’s stated mission and plans.

item.title: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model (155 responses)
item.description: Hacker News discussion of a report that Workers AI served cross-request KV cache data in 155 responses of a GLM model.

item.title: Groundhog Day for AI agents: Prompt caching patterns for using OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: AWS post describing prompt caching patterns for agent workloads that call OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock.

item.title: How Black-Box Distillation Works
item.description: CSET explainer on how black-box distillation works and why it matters for policy.

item.title: How NVIDIA Mission Control 2.5 Brings Autonomous Recovery to Kubernetes
item.description: NVIDIA post on Mission Control 2.5, which adds automatic recovery for AI workloads on Kubernetes.

item.title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
item.description: Preprint on a data-free way for a language model to improve itself through on-policy training, with Google-affiliated authors.

item.title: Interpretable sparse fine-tuning with TopKLoRA enables faithful circuit discovery
item.description: Preprint proposing a sparse variant of LoRA fine-tuning meant to make the resulting circuits easier to trace inside a model.

item.title: Fooling LLM Safety Guards into Judging the Wrong Text
item.description: Preprint showing ways to make LLM safety guard models judge the wrong text.

item.title: $\Psi$-0.6: Adaptive Streams of Thought in a Unified Vision-Language World Model
item.description: Preprint on a unified vision-language world model that adapts how many reasoning streams it runs, from a Stanford-linked author group.

item.title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin cancer diagnosis
item.description: Community-shared item claiming an older convolutional network beats frontier language models at skin cancer diagnosis; the title gives no detail on method.

item.title: Google’s AI search changes upended online publishing
item.description: The Verge covers how Google's AI search changes have disrupted online publishing.

item.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
item.description: OpenAI describes how it secures the environment used to train its frontier models.

item.title: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
item.description: The Verge reports OpenAI trains its frontier models without internet access.

item.title: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro
item.description: Simon Willison's note on the release of Kimi K3.1 Pro.

item.title: PHP2Shell: Haven’t patched yet? Take these steps now to mitigate
item.description: ZDNET gives mitigation steps for the PHP2Shell vulnerability for unpatched systems.

item.title: [AINews] Kimi 3.1 Pro 104BA-2.8T: Fable-5.1-Class Open Weights narrows Closed-AI lead to 1 month... and Pro Highspeed API with 2-3× speed
item.description: Latent Space roundup covering a Kimi 3.1 Pro open-weights release and a faster API tier.

item.title: Does Your Model Run on AWS Trainium? Look It Up
item.description: Hugging Face post pointing to a lookup for checking whether a model runs on AWS Trainium.

item.title: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
item.description: WIRED reports a Hugging Face biology model that lets users chat with DNA.

item.description: Latent Space AINews notes OpenAI’s Patch the Planet program as one of two parties to find the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities.

item.title: Hackers Exploited the PHP Vulnerabilities Days Before They Were Patched
item.description: WIRED reports hackers exploited the PHP flaws days before patches arrived.

item.title: Uber brings ChatGPT Work to all employees with OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI announces that Uber is rolling out ChatGPT Work to its whole workforce.

item.title: Running Frontier-Class AI Models Across 8 NVIDIA DGX Spark Nodes
item.description: NVIDIA post on running very large models across eight DGX Spark nodes.

item.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
item.description: Hacker News discussion of an article arguing that LLMs make formal software verification feasible at much larger scale.

item.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
item.description: OpenAI says its models are coming to Google Cloud, adding a second major cloud route to them. Details come from OpenAI's own announcement.

item.title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
item.description: OpenAI describes a program to coordinate global response as AI agents uncover critical software vulnerabilities.

item.title: [AINews] DeepSeek DeepInfer: Open Source SOTA Inference running 155T toks/day/cluster making $22m/day at ~80% margin for a 81 day payback
item.description: Newsletter on DeepSeek DeepInfer, an open inference stack said to serve 155T tokens a day per cluster and earn $22m a day.

item.title: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
item.description: The Verge reports Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a new agent, to take on Meta's Muse.

item.title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
item.description: OpenAI describes using thousands of AI agents to find new leads in biological data.

item.title: Today's PHP Security Release, and How We're Strengthening PHP Security
item.description: Simon Willison's note on today's PHP security release and how PHP's security is being strengthened.

item.title: Meta Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations
item.description: Ars Technica reports that sharing Muse conversations can expose personal and business information to others.

item.title: Introducing TorchTPU
item.description: The PyTorch project introduces TorchTPU, a way to run PyTorch workloads on Google TPUs natively.

item.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
item.description: TechCrunch reports the US has ordered federal agencies to remove DeepSeek AI from their systems.

item.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
item.description: TechCrunch reports Anthropic is proposing a safety bill that could block a model if it might cause mass casualties.

item.title: Inside NVIDIA Sentry: Secure AI Agents at Runtime
item.description: NVIDIA technical post on Sentry, a runtime layer meant to secure AI agents while they execute.

item.title: NVIDIA Cosmos3-H-Dreams: Bringing Clinical Surgery to Life Through Generative Simulation
item.description: Hugging Face post on an NVIDIA Cosmos model that generates simulated clinical surgery scenes.
